summary: Follow parcels through an invented sorter whose routing decisions and queues are inspectable.
objective: Create an invented parcel sorter with arrival, scan, divert and exit events I can step through.
example_prompts: Create an invented parcel sorter with arrival, scan, divert and exit events I can step through.
Pause a chute and show which parcels are blocked.

entities.name: Conveyor and gates
entities.guidance: Model belt bed, rollers, side rails and a diverter with a visible pivot.

entities.name: Parcels and chutes
entities.guidance: Use distinct package sizes, persistent labels and destination-coded chute mouths.

object_craft.structure: Model belt bed, rollers, side rails and a diverter with a visible pivot.
object_craft.material: Dark belt, galvanized-looking rails and painted gate.

object_craft.structure: Use distinct package sizes, persistent labels and destination-coded chute mouths.
object_craft.material: Kraft paper and matte chute panels.

state_contract.model: Authored discrete-event model: unique parcel IDs, destination, queue position, scanner status and chute capacity; ordered events use time plus stable sequence tie-break.
state_contract.authority: Domain state owns identities, values and accepted transitions. Derive labels and meshes from that state; camera and display offsets are separate.
actions: Inspect parcel history and reset the same input schedule.

invariants: Each parcel belongs to exactly one queue, transit segment or exited set.
A full destination blocks transfer; a parcel cannot vanish.
Reset restores event queue, capacities and parcel history.
motion_guidance: Interpolate travel only between committed event endpoints; pause interpolation with event time.
Diverter pose follows the selected transfer rather than an independent decorative oscillation.
known_limits: Synthetic operations scenario; arrival/service times are explicit authored inputs, not measured throughput.
No conveyor traction, crushing or real equipment control.
Authored recipe only; runtime and rendered geometry checks have not run.
creative_affordances: Visible chute mouths and persistent parcel markings connect queue state to spatial routing.

colliders: Lane and package envelopes for spacing validation.
contact: No collision response; queue spacing and route assignment are model rules.
physical_contract.timestep: Use a declared fixed update step for changing model state; interpolate presentation only. Pause clears accumulated playback time.
checks: Blocked chute retains parcel; replay has identical event order.
